usageNotes: Use this to cancel a queued 'Clear Key' action on a specific remote/node pair without discarding all other pending changes in the pool. This is the surgical undo for a misqueued clear — the subscription binding remains intact so the operator can re-queue or leave the live key in place. Pass the current config digest to guard against concurrent modifications racing this reversal.

examples.summary: Revert a queued key clear for node 'pve-node1' on remote 'hetzner-prod'

tips: This targets one remote/node pair only — use the global Discard Pending path if you need to roll back all pending changes at once.
The digest param is optional but recommended in automated workflows to prevent a concurrent operator change from being silently overwritten.
Returns null on success; treat any non-2xx response as a sign the pending clear was already applied or the binding no longer exists.
